name: lesson13_14git_and_github
description: 1. make sure you already setting your your gift to connect to github ```shell git config --global user.name "your_username" git config --global user.email "your_email" ``` 2. open vscode, terminal -> new terminal -> cmd (hit enter) 3. type git init ```shell git init ```shell git branch -m main ``` 5. connect your git local and use github using this command ```shell git remote add origin https://your-repository-url ``` 6. stage all changes using ```shell git add . 7. give message before send it to github ```shell git commit -m "your message" // for example "first commit" ``` 8. push your code using git push ```shell git push origin main ```
